name: 417. Veo on the video routes, Vertex and the Gemini API: fields delivered or refused, filtered videos, provider_status, %2F task ids, cancel (vertex endpoint fixture, provider error fixture, vertex veo contract) [SERIAL]
description: Pins contract C4, C5, C6, C7 and C9 for Veo on Vertex (TXE-6537) against the local Vertex fixture; no network traffic leaves the machine. Run tests/e2e/api/runners/vertex-endpoint-fixture.mjs --app-dir <dir>, start an isolated gateway with -app-dir <dir>, and run with vertexEndpointFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. Keys are selected with x-bf-api-key. The fixture answers :predictLongRunning with an operation named after the model path, and :fetchPredictOperation by the id after /operations/: veo-partly-filtered (one video in the caller's bucket, one inline, one filtered), veo-all-filtered, veo-running, veo-failed. Row 1: a create sends output_storage_uri as parameters.storageUri, aspect_ratio, resolution, last_frame and reference_images under the vendor's names, and fps, pubsubTopic and task inside parameters, with nothing repeated at the top level; the task object has provider_status and no seconds. Rows 2 to 5: a size Veo does not render, an http first frame and callback_url are each 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming the field with no upstream call, on /v1/videos and on /openai/v1/videos. Row 6: the Gemini-shaped route delivers a gcsUri first frame, storageUri and the Vertex parameters. Rows 7 to 9: a query by a %2F task id reaches Vertex as one operation name; a partly filtered task is completed with two videos and content_filter, the bucket artifact a content entry with no url; a fully filtered one is failed with content_filter; provider_status is done=false, done=true or done=true,error.code=<n>. Row 10: cancel is 400 provider_cancel_unsupported with no upstream call. Red before the change: storageUri was sent as storageURI and output_storage_uri was refused; an unknown size was sent as 16:9; the http frame was sent as a bare mimeType; fps, pubsubTopic and task landed at the top level; the filtered count was not read, so a fully filtered task was completed; the bucket artifact was a url entry; provider_status was absent; the create response carried seconds from the request. Streaming the gs:// artifact through GET /v1/videos/{id}/content is pinned by the Go test (vertex TestVertexVideoDownloadStreamsGCSArtifact). Rows 11 to 16 are the Gemini API, which shares the converter, against the provider error fixture (providerErrorFixture=1; skipped otherwise): size 1920x1080 is aspectRatio 16:9 and resolution 1080p, first and last frame go as bytes, and the create response has no seconds; reference_images go as asset references with aspect_ratio and resolution as given; a size outside Veo's table, a gs:// last frame (only Vertex takes gcsUri) and an http first frame are each 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming the field with no upstream call; the Gemini-shaped route delivers the frames and parameters as sent. Red before the change on these rows: 1920x1080 sent no resolution, 1024x1024 was sent as 16:9, last_frame and reference_images were not delivered, and the http frame was sent as a bare mimeType.
